question: what native Emilia object commits the population whose coverage is being claimed?

mechanisms: CAP-1 carries the producer-declared coverage statement
examined-set verifier checks explicit eligible/examined membership and one result binding per examined unit
CAP-1 subject digest commits eligible-set and examined-set roots plus claim/profile metadata
coverage composition binds the exact CAP-1 digest as census_digest
the signed reconciliation attestation binds supplied population roots and the relying-party reconciliation program

portable_invariant: closed examined-set coverage != proof that the source population itself was complete
resolution: AirTrajectory does not need to propose a new Emilia coverage primitive; the crosswalk maps to CAP-1/examined-set composition while preserving source-population completeness as a separately proven boundary.
non_claims: This is not Emilia maintainer endorsement.
This does not claim CAP-1 proves source-population truth.
This does not claim every AirTrajectory coverage vector is an Emilia conformance vector.
